Mirrors scripts/humanoidbench/shared/rcb_hb.py, so an agent works the same way across simulators.

Concepts
--------
instance    instance.json: which KinDER environment, the seed its procedural generator builds the scene from, the
            episode length, and a digest of the scene that seed builds. KinDER regenerates a scene from its seed, bit
            for bit; the digest catches the day it stops doing so.
trajectory  (T, D) actions, one row per 10 Hz control step, in KinDER's own action space (`s.action_space`).
            Replayed open-loop from the instance, it reproduces bit for bit (CPU MuJoCo).
success     KinDER's own goal check -- the environment's `terminated` -- at any step within the episode. The episode
            ends there.

Python API
----------
  from rcb_kinder import Session
